title: Inibuilds A350 auto THS correction
short_description: This add-on provides Mobiflight configuration files to address the automatic Trimmable Horizontal Stabilizer behavior issues in the Inibuilds A350 after version 1.2.1. The configs restore correct auto-trim response during rollout and touch-and-go by either directly setting trim values or using the pitch trim switch. Users can choose between immediate response or smoother, more gradual trim movement. The add-on is tested for MSFS 2024 with potential compatibility for MSFS 2020.

title: Boeing 747-8i/8F Mobliflight Logitech Switch Panel Profile
short_description: This profile enables compatibility between the Logitech Switch Panel and the Boeing 747-8i and 8F in Microsoft Flight Simulator via Mobiflight. It includes custom keybinds for battery, APU, IRS, lights, anti-ice, fuel pumps, and engine controls tailored to the aircraft. Landing gear indicators and relevant LEDs are mapped for accurate status feedback. The profile aims to streamline hardware interaction for improved functionality within the 747-8 series.

title: Inibuilds A330-300/200 Logitech Switch Panel Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the Inibuilds A330-300 and A330-200, designed for use with the Logitech Switch Panel in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It offers specific bindings for aircraft systems such as battery, external power, APU start, ADIRS, fuel pumps, anti-ice, lights, and landing gear including LED functionality. All main switch panel functions are mapped for seamless operation with the simulated A330 models. Suitable for users seeking direct hardware integration and enhanced cockpit control.

title: Mobiflight Wingflex RMP Cube for the Synaptic A22X
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for integrating the Wingflex RMP Cube hardware with the Synaptic A22X, supporting VHF1 and basic transponder controls. It is designed for use via Mobiflight Beta, utilizing MFPROJ files. While created for Synaptic A22X compatibility, it has not been tested specifically with MSFS2020. User feedback is encouraged for ongoing improvements.

title: WinCtrl NWS + RMP L - Fenix A320 MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This profile enables advanced integration of WinWing controls with the Fenix A320 in Microsoft Flight Simulator via MobiFlight. It provides accurate nose wheel steering pedal disconnect and synchronized backlighting with the aircraft lighting system. The add-on also resolves slow frequency selection and LCD backlighting consistency issues on the Radio Management Panel. Proper setup requires HidHide and specific device configurations for seamless operation.

title: PMDG 737x MOZA MB7F Mobiflight profile
short_description: This addon provides a Mobiflight profile for integrating the MB7F Flight Management System with all PMDG 737 variants in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The profile aims to enhance compatibility and stability when using Moza hardware. Users must have the latest Mobiflight beta installed for full support. Simple installation involves unpacking and importing the configuration files into Mobiflight.

title: Profil  Octavi IFR-1  baro ISIS
short_description: This modification updates the Mobiflight Fenix A320 add-on to redirect the barometer adjustment from the EFIS panel to the ISIS using the Octavi IFR-1, specifically via the COM2 key. It allows the Octavi IFR-1 to remain functional alongside the Wingflex panel without conflicts. Only the baro adjustment is changed; all other functions and buttons remain as in the original Mobiflight file. Activation through Mobiflight is required.

title: WINCTRL FCU & EFIS for Generic AP & G1000 - MobiFlight Profile (MSFS 2024)
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables integration of WINCTRL FCU and EFIS controls with the Generic Asobo autopilot and Garmin G1000 NXi systems in MSFS 2024. It supports full autopilot operation, frequency tuning, FMS management, and dedicated button functions for compatible aircraft. Additional features include OBS mode, barometric adjustment, and map zoom control. Designed for Asobo aircraft with the Garmin G1000 NXi, such as the Cessna 172, DA40, DA62, and SR22.

title: Mobiflight 757 Bluebird - TCA Airbus Quadrant
short_description: This add-on provides a custom MobiFlight profile for the BlueBird Simulations 757, designed for use with the Thrustmaster TCA Airbus Quadrant. It enables cockpit functions such as the autobrake selector, fuel cutoff switches, and parking brake, which are not available through standard control bindings. Throttle, flap, landing gear and speedbrake axes remain managed within Microsoft Flight Simulator. The profile requires MSFS, MobiFlight, the BlueBird 757, and the TCA Airbus Quadrant.

title: BlueBird Sim 757 - PRODESKSIM 737 Overhead Panel - MobiFlight for BB757
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight configuration for using the ProDeskSim 737 overhead panel with the BlueBirdSim 757. All switches and functions are mapped appropriately, with the exception of the retract light switches, which are assigned to No Smoking and Seatbelt signs. The configuration aims to enhance hardware compatibility between the panels and aircraft. Installation enables direct use of physical overhead controls in the BB757 cockpit simulator.

title: BlueBird 757 – WINWING PFP4 CDU MobiFlight Profile (MSFS 2024)
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the WINWING PFP4 Captain CDU, tailored for use with the BlueBird Simulations Boeing 757 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It enables functional CDU display, keypad buttons, annunciators, and adjustable screen brightness, including synchronization with the virtual cockpit controls. Keypad backlighting is tied to the aircraft's aisle stand lighting knob. The profile is based on previous work, updated for improved compatibility and features with the PFP4 unit.

title: [Mobiflight Preset] MOZA MA3F Bluebird B757-200/-300 Keys
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for integrating the MOZA MA3F Flight Computer Display with the BlueBird 757-200 and 757-300 aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It requires the latest MobiFlight beta with MOZA MA3F support. Users must assign the hardware in Controller Bindings before running the configuration. Box prompts in the Boeing FMC currently show as question marks on the MA3F.

title: MobiFlight - WINCTRL URSA MINOR 32 Throttle Metal / 32 PAC Metal Profile for PMDG 737-800
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables seamless use of the WINCTRL URSA MINOR 32 Throttle Metal and 32 PAC Metal hardware with the PMDG 737-800 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It eliminates the need to switch between single and dual axis modes in SimAppPro by using custom logic for throttle, reverse thrust, and other controls. Key functions include integrated throttle mapping, parking brake, speedbrake, flaps, and rudder trim compatibility. The profile simplifies setup and enhances compatibility by centralizing control logic within MobiFlight.

title: Bluebird 757 MOZA MB7F Mobiflight profile
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile enabling compatibility between the MB7F hardware and the Bluebird 757 FMC in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It is based on an existing WINCTRL PFP3N profile, with button mappings adjusted for the MB7F. FMCCOM and NAVRAD functions are not assigned due to hardware limitations but can be manually mapped if desired. Installation involves unpacking the profile and loading it into your Mobiflight configuration.

title: BlueBird 757 WINCTRL EFIS L&R, FCU, MCDU and RMP AIO Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the Winwing WINCTRL RMP32 hardware in conjunction with the BlueBird 757 aircraft. It provides functions for panel selection, radio tuning, HF and ILS modes, and power management. The controls include frequency adjustment, active-standby swap, and lighting indicators. Display and button backlighting are set to full brightness for clear visibility.

title: FSReborn Phenom 300E - WinCTRL FCU + EFIS Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for integrating the FSReborn Phenom 300E with WinCTRL FCU and optional EFIS L/R hardware. It replicates Airbus-style automation logic, allowing users to switch between automatic and manual control modes. The profile features optional bindings for controlling hardware lights and the TEST button. Known limitations include certain display mismatches due to G3000 constraints.

title: Rowsfire A106 V3 Mobiflight Profile - iniBuilds A350
short_description: This Mobiflight profile adapts the Rowsfire A106 V3 mini-overhead hardware panel for use with the iniBuilds A350 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. The configuration maps the panel’s buttons and switches to A350-specific systems and controls, including batteries, fuel pumps, lights, anti-ice, ADIRS selectors, and more. Indicator LEDs and certain controls are reassigned or combined to match A350 operations. Compatible hardware and prior MobiFlight setup are required for use.

title: MobiFlight PFP3N Profile for BlueBird 757-200
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the PFP3N hardware, tailored to the BlueBird 757-200 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. Key button assignments such as DES, CRZ, and CLB have been re-mapped to correspond with in-game functions. Most buttons are correctly assigned for compatibility with the aircraft. The profile is adapted from an existing PFP7N profile.

title: Wingflex RMP Cube - PMDG 737/777 Profiles
short_description: This add-on provides detailed profiles for the Wingflex RMP Cube, tailored for use with the PMDG 737 and 777 aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It enables functionality such as VHF radio management, including active and standby swapping and full knob support. The package also includes TCAS mode selection and advanced ATC transponder code input using intuitive button combinations. Designed to replicate real-world RMP interactions for improved simulation realism.

title: Bluebird 757 - PDS 7X7 Fuel Cut Off Panel
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight configuration for integrating the ProDeskSim Stand Alone B7X7 panel with the BlueBird 757 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It enables mapping of functions such as fuel cut off levers, parking brake, and auto brake up to setting 4. Engine start and autopilot controls are assigned to main electric and autopilot switches, respectively. The push button remains unmapped in this configuration.

title: Bluebird 757 PDC3 Mobiflight
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the WinCtrl PDC3 hardware to be used with the Bluebird 757 aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It enables integration and control of specific cockpit functions such as FPV, MTRS, RST, and minimums settings directly through Mobiflight Connector. The package includes installation instructions and details on feature mapping. Users are advised not to run SimAppPro simultaneously with this profile.

title: Bluebird 757 Winwing MCDU
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile specifically for the Winwing MCDU hardware, tailored for use with the Bluebird 757 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It maps key MCDU functions such as route planning, flight performance, VNAV, and ATC to the corresponding buttons. Special assignments include DELETE on the bottom blank button and EXECUTE on the top right blank button. The profile aims to enhance MCDU hardware integration for more efficient cockpit operation.

title: Bluebird B757 WINCTRL MCDU Mobiflight Profile
short_description: Enhanced MobiFlight profile for the WINWING WINCTRL MCDU and BlueBird Boeing 757 in MSFS 2024. Features adapted FMC keybindings, automatic LCD brightness synchronization, and keypad backlighting linked to the aircraft's cockpit lighting controls.

title: Bluebird 757 PFP3N Mobiflight
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile configured for the WinCtrl PFP3 autopilot panel, specifically tailored for the Bluebird 757 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It is a conversion of Lich's original PFP7 profile to work with the PFP3N hardware. Installation instructions are included for easy setup with MobiFlight Connector. SimAppPro should not be used simultaneously with this profile.

title: Bluebird 757 PAP3 Mobiflight
short_description: This is a Mobiflight profile enabling compatibility between the WinCtrl PAP3 hardware panel and the Bluebird 757 aircraft. The profile facilitates control integration but has limitations, including non-functional autothrottle arming and disengage bar due to current aircraft constraints. Installation requires extracting the files and configuring bindings within the Mobiflight Connector. Some functions such as HDG HOLD and B/CRS are not bound and may require manual reassignment.

title: BlueBird 757 | miniCOCKPIT miniFCU + LEFT miniEFIS | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile maps the miniCOCKPIT miniFCU and LEFT miniEFIS hardware to the BlueBird 757’s autopilot and captain-side EFIS controls, reassigning Airbus panel functions for Boeing use. A secondary FN layer accessed via the EXPED button enables additional features without extra hardware. The profile supports comprehensive control over autopilot, navigation, and EFIS display functions, with LEDs indicating secondary mode activation. Compatibility requires the BlueBird Simulations 757, relevant miniCOCKPIT panels, and MobiFlight Connector with WASM support.

title: WinCtrl PAP3 Mobiflight Profile for the BlueBird B757-200
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables full control of the BlueBird B757-200 using the WinCtrl PAP3 hardware panel. All buttons, switches, and displays are functional, with custom mappings provided for various flight functions. The configuration includes specific assignments for autopilot and mode selector controls. PDC support is planned for future updates.

title: Bluebird B757 WINCTRL PFP7 Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight configuration profile for using the PFP7 panel as a CDU keyboard with the Bluebird B757 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The files are designed to be installed in the Mobiflight configuration folder. Compatibility with the 2020 version of the simulator is not confirmed, but may be possible. The add-on offers enhanced control integration for supported hardware setups.

title: BlueBird 757-200 | WinWing FCU MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile links the WinWing or WinCtrl FCU hardware with the BlueBird Simulations 757-200 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 and 2024. It enables cockpit controls including speed, heading, altitude, vertical speed, and button mappings using BlueBird’s MCP L-Vars. The setup requires MobiFlight Connector and module, and does not support writable rotary variables due to simulator limitations. Functionality was validated by the creator but not independently tested on all hardware.

title: H145  - OVHD Panel Front Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the front overhead panels of the HYPE H145 helicopter in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It includes functional bindings for various switches and controls available on the overhead panel. The profile aims to enhance hardware integration and support cockpit builders. The bindings are based on accessible simulation functions found within the H145 model.

title: Inibuilds A350 Rowsfire A107 Pro MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables full hardware integration between the iniBuilds Airbus A350 for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and the Rowsfire A107 Pro overhead panel. It features complete mappings for lighting, electrical systems, dual-channel batteries, and the 6-pump fuel architecture. Input logic addresses instant response and sync between hardware and simulator, including support for annunciator and dimming controls. Installation requires the latest MobiFlight Connector and specific device setup steps.

title: Inibuilds A380 Rowsfire A107 Pro MobibFlight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile designed to map the A107 Pro Overhead Panel controls to the Inibuilds A380 aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It ensures accurate functionality and compatibility between the hardware panel and the simulated aircraft. Users can expect improved integration for more realistic cockpit interaction. The profile is tailored specifically for those using the A107 Pro with the Inibuilds A380.

title: Hoowalt D201 & D203 – PMDG Boeing 777-300ER | MSFS 2024 | MobiFlight
short_description: This MobiFlight configuration enables full integration of the Hoowalt D201 Radio Panel and D203 ATC Transponder Panel with the PMDG Boeing 777-300ER in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It provides functional setup for communications radios, transponder controls, and TCAS modes using dedicated hardware. The profile includes accurate assignments for COM radio management and squawk code operations but does not support NAV tuning. Compatibility is specific to the PMDG 777-300ER and may require manual device mapping in MobiFlight.

title: Mobiflight PMDG 777 Complete
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the PMDG 777-300ER in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It includes compatibility with several WINWING hardware products, such as Winctrl panels and the Rowsfire B107 737 Overhead Panel. The download provides a ready-to-use configuration for improved integration. Installation instructions are included for easy setup with Mobiflight.

title: WingFlex - GMP - FBW A320 (Dev)
short_description: This add-on provides integration of the WingFlex GMP unit with the FlyByWire A320 for Microsoft Flight Simulator using MobiFlight. All currently available functions in the FBW A320 are supported except specific UTC-related features, which lack access via WASM or SimConnect. The project focuses on extending hardware compatibility within the simulator environment. Some GMP unit buttons remain non-functional due to technical limitations.

title: Mobiflight Profiles for SL3 panels/FSLABS A321
short_description: This package provides 11 individual Mobiflight profiles designed for SL3 hardware panels, specifically tailored for use with the FSLABS A321. It includes configurations for panels such as the Ecam, Weather Radar, both CPT and FO PFD/ND, and various lighting and warning panels. All profiles have been tested with the latest Mobiflight version on a home simulator setup. Users can simply unzip and load the needed profiles for their SL3 panels.

title: Winctrl TCAS for PMDG 737
short_description: This add-on provides a TCAS display for Mobiflight profiles used with the PMDG 737 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It shows the active code set and enables full functionality of all buttons. Additional switch support will be included in future updates. The tool aims to improve hardware integration with the PMDG 737 systems.

title: Wingflex FCU and EFIS cube Mobiflight Fenix profiles
short_description: This MobiFlight profile is designed for use with the Wingflex FCU and EFIS hardware, specifically for the Fenix A320 series in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 and 2024. The profile removes the need to run the official Wingflex control software, allowing unified hardware management through MobiFlight for devices from different manufacturers. It aims to simplify pre-flight setup for users with multiple peripherals. There is a known issue affecting the annunciator light test function in the A320.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL RMP | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the WINCTRL RMP module, designed specifically for the iniBuilds Airbus A380-800 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It enables real-time synchronization of hardware lighting and RMP display with the simulator, including support for various radio controls such as VHF1, VHF2, HF1, HF2, frequency swap, and power functions. The profile requires MobiFlight Connector v11.2.0.7 (Beta) or later and does not require SimApp Pro. Certain features like VHF3, AM, and NAV controls are not supported.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL MCDU | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables hardware integration for the iniBuilds Airbus A380-800 MCDU using the WINCTRL 32 Captain panel. It supports synchronized lighting for backlights and annunciators, with hardware lighting following the aircraft state in real time. Many MCDU controls are included, though certain functions are not supported. Compatible with MobiFlight Connector v11.2.0.7 (Beta) or newer.
