title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL AGP | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the iniBuilds Airbus A380-800 and supports comprehensive control and lighting synchronization without requiring SimApp Pro. It is developed and fully tested with Mobiflight Connector v11.2.0.7 (Beta) or newer. The profile enables real-time hardware lighting and AGP display synchronization, supporting nearly all cockpit controls. Reference images detailing button mapping and functions are included.

title: Glare Wing SIM GAUGES || FSLABS || MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the compact Glare Wing module, tailored specifically for the FSLabs A321ceo. It features fully functional hardware lighting, with CHRONO and Side Stick Priority intensity synchronized to the FCU dimmer. Most buttons are active, except for those not implemented in the base aircraft, such as AUTO LAND. Real-time status updates ensure hardware indicators match the aircraft's current state.

title: Rowsfire A117 Glareshield Panel | Mobiflight Profile | Fenix A320
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables full integration of the Rowsfire A117C captain-side glareshield panel with the Fenix A320 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 or 2024. All main buttons, annunciators, and the backlight are supported, including Master Warn, Master Caut, Autoland, Sidestick Priority, and Chrono functions. The backlight adjusts according to the FCU INTEG LT knob. Requires a Rowsfire A117C panel with MobiFlight firmware and the Fenix A320 aircraft.

title: Moza MGX1000 - Asobo SR22T Profile (MSFS2024 Only)
short_description: This add-on provides a custom Moza MGX1000 mapping profile tailored for the Asobo Cirrus SR22T in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, compatible with the pilot flight display only. It addresses the lack of native support for the MGX1000 with this aircraft model. Users must utilize Mobiflight for setup and ensure compatible firmware and cockpit configuration. The profile aims to enhance hardware integration for improved device functionality within MSFS2024.

title: FSS E-Jets | WINCTRL PAP3 + PDC 3M L + RMP + MCDU | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables hardware integration for the FlightSim Studio E-Jets (E170, E175, E190, E195), supporting WINCTRL MCP, EFIS, RMP, and MCDU Captain devices. Key aircraft controls and displays, annunciators, and backlighting are mapped to compatible hardware units. Basic Thrustmaster HOTAS Warthog functions are included. Requires a recent MobiFlight version with WinCtrl support, with no need for SimAppPro.

title: MobiFlight - WINCTRL 32 AGP Metal Profile for Aerosoft A340-600
short_description: This MobiFlight profile adds comprehensive support for the WINWING AGP Metal Panel when used with the Aerosoft A340-600 Pro in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It enables key panel functions such as autobrake modes with annunciators, landing gear controls, anti-skid, chrono display, and adjustable lighting. The profile uses direct integration with Aerosoft A340 variables for enhanced reliability. Some features may be limited by current simulator and aircraft add-on constraints.

title: Synaptic A220 WinCtrl FCU/EFIS/MCDU/Throttles Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile provides functional mappings for FCU, EFIS, MCDU, and throttle controls for the A220 with WinCtrl hardware. Individual components are organized in separate files for easy customization. FCU behavior follows typical Airbus logic, and both baro and all FCU displays are supported. Some button and display functions remain unbound due to hardware limitations.

title: Moza G1000 Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the Moza G1000 hardware and supports one display with a swap button for switching between the PFD and MFD. It is compatible with default Asobo G1000 keybinds and has been tested with the COWS DA-40 and DA-42 aircraft. Setup instructions are provided for integration with the Moza Cockpit app and MSFS Pop Out Manager. The profile is freely editable and redistributable for non-commercial use with appropriate credit.

title: Rowsfire A103 v3 - Synaptic A220 Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a configuration file for using the Rowsfire A103 ECAM Panel with the Synaptic A220 aircraft in Mobiflight. It is designed to improve compatibility and functionality between the panel and the aircraft. Users can implement this profile for more accurate ECAM operation. Recommendations and feedback on performance are encouraged for further development.

title: Horizon Simulations 787-9 Mobiflight Profile for WINCTRL PAP3
short_description: This add-on provides a custom Mobiflight profile for the Horizon Simulations 787-9 aircraft tailored for the WINCTRL PAP3 hardware. It aims to offer a more user-friendly, plug-and-play option compared to existing profiles, addressing compatibility issues with the winwing rebrand. The profile has not been tested in MSFS 2020 and users are advised to use it at their own discretion. Installation instructions are included, and users can report bugs for further development.

title: FlightFX Citation X - WINCTRL FCU/EFIS
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the FlightFX Citation X, compatible with the WinCtrl FCU and left EFIS. It enables control of autopilot functions including speed, heading, altitude, and vertical speed. A secondary layer accessed by the TRK key allows for course selection and barometric minimums adjustment. Displays and indicator lights are synchronized with the aircraft's systems.

title: FlightFX Hawker 800XP - WINCTRL FCU/EFIS
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile tailored for the FlightFX Hawker 800XP, designed for use with the WinCtrl FCU and EFIS hardware. It enables control over autopilot functions, including speed, heading, altitude, and vertical speed settings. The profile also supports EFIS display management and barometric adjustments, with a dedicated layer for course and avionics menu control. All hardware displays and lights are synchronized with the aircraft in the simulator.

title: FlightFX Hawker 800XP - WINCTRL PAP3/PDC
short_description: This add-on offers a customized MobiFlight profile for the FlightFX Hawker 800XP, compatible with the WinCtrl PAP3 and captain PDC hardware. The PAP3 manages autopilot, autothrottle, and flight director functions with real-time displays and mode indicators. The PDC is responsible for barometric settings, avionics menus, and display page navigation. Layered controls allow efficient access to primary adjustment and multi-function display menus.

title: Fenix A320 WINCTRL NWS TILLER MOBIFLIGHT
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables support for the WINCTRL NWS tiller on the Fenix A320, specifically for the captain's side. Users can adapt it for first officer use by importing and adjusting SIMVARs. The profile includes pedal disc button functionality, steering, and dynamic backlight features. Designed for integration with compatible hardware controllers.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL(Winwing) TCAS | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables full TCAS hardware integration for the iniBuilds Airbus A380 using the WINCTRL 32 controller. Features include real-time lighting synchronization, TCAS display alignment, and comprehensive support for mode, XPDR, and IDENT controls. No SimApp Pro is needed, but the ALT RPTG switch is not supported. Developed and tested for MobiFlight Connector v11.2.0.7 (Beta) or newer.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL(Winwing) Joystick | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables integration of the Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 with the WINCTRL URSA MINOR 32 joystick using MobiFlight Connector v11.2.0.7 or newer. It offers fully synchronized hardware lighting, hardware vibration simulation, and mapped autopilot disconnect functionality. No SimApp Pro is required, and axis input mapping is not included. The profile has been specifically tested with the listed MobiFlight Connector version for compatibility.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL(Winwing) Throttle Metal & PAC Metal | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables synchronized lighting and output functions for the WINWING URSA MINOR 32 Throttle Metal and PAC Metal controllers with the iniBuilds Airbus A380-800. It is compatible with MobiFlight Connector v11.2.0.7 Beta or newer and supports real-time lighting effects and vibration simulation. No SimApp Pro is required. The profile is limited to output functions, with no button mapping included.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL(Winwing) ECAM | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables integration of the WINWING ECAM hardware with the iniBuilds Airbus A380-800 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It requires MobiFlight Connector version 11.2.0.7 (Beta) or newer for full functionality. The profile features real-time synchronized ECAM displays and lighting, including backlighting and annunciators. Button mappings and configuration details are provided with the package.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL(Winwing) FCU+EFIS  L&R | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile provides full FCU and EFIS integration for the iniBuilds Airbus A380-800 using the WINCTRL Winwing FCU-32 and EFIS-32L/R hardware units. It offers synchronized lighting, display synchronization, and comprehensive support for autopilot and EFIS controls without needing SimApp Pro. The profile is developed for MobiFlight Connector v11.2.0.7 (Beta) or newer, with detailed mappings provided in the included documentation. Compatibility is verified only for specific hardware combinations as outlined.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A380-800 | WINCTRL(Winwing) NWS | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables integration between the WINCTRL 32 NWS hardware and the iniBuilds Airbus A380-800 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It provides synchronized lighting and preconfigured button mappings for nose wheel steering pedal disc functions, with no requirement for SimApp Pro. The profile is fully tested with MobiFlight Connector v11.2.0.7 (Beta) or newer. Use of earlier MobiFlight versions may lead to limited functionality.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) NWS | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables compatibility between the Winwing WINCTRL 32 controller and the iniBuilds Airbus A350 series in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It offers fully synchronized hardware lighting and dedicated button mappings, such as PEDAL DISC, without the need for SimApp Pro. Nose Wheel Steering axis mapping is not included. The profile requires MobiFlight Connector v11.1.0.8 (Beta) or later for proper operation.

title: SkySimulations DC-9 Winctrl FCU and URSA
short_description: This add-on provides custom profiles for the Winctrl FCU and URSA throttle, tailored for the SkySimulations DC-9 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It supports engine switch and ignition controls, engine start valve operation, and full functionality for all FCU knobs including speed, heading, altitude, and vertical speed. Detailed mappings allow use of autopilot, navigation, and approach modes. Users can further adapt the configuration for other controllers using Mobiflight.

title: Mobiflight Rowsfire A107 V3.0 for the Inibuilds A380 Airliner
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables compatibility between the Rowsfire A107 V3.0 and the Inibuilds A380 Airliner. It requires the Mobiflight beta version due to its use of MFPROJ files. The profile currently has a known issue with the OVHD INTEG LT function. User feedback for issues is encouraged.

title: WINWING / WINCTRL PAP3, 3N PDC Mobiflight Profile for FlightFX Hawker 800XP
short_description: This add-on offers a Mobiflight profile tailored for the FlightFX Hawker 800XP, supporting WINWING and WINCTRL PAP3 as well as 3N PDC EFIS modules. It requires the latest beta version of Mobiflight for full compatibility. Device mapping should be configured according to the included reference images. The profile enables enhanced hardware integration for supported cockpit modules.

title: Mobiflight WinCtrl FCU/EFIS/MCDU/Throtttle for FFX Hawker 800XP
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables compatibility for WinCtrl FCU, EFIS, MCDU, and Throttle hardware with the FFX Hawker 800XP in Microsoft Flight Simulator. Separate component files are included for customization, covering both left and right EFIS with some unmapped controls, and offering standard Airbus mappings for the FCU. The MCDU is supported with customizable page key mapping, and throttle bindings allow basic engine start functions. The add-on is intended for use with hardware panels to enhance aircraft control integration.

title: Generic WinCtrl RMP MobiFlight Profile (Any Aircraft, COM1 + Squawk)
short_description: This add-on provides a generic MobiFlight profile for the Winwing WinCtrl RMP, enabling standard COM1 standby frequency tuning, active/standby transfer, and transponder squawk code editing in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It uses only default SimConnect events and variables for broad compatibility with default and most third-party aircraft. The profile supports VHF1/VHF2 transmit-select and backlight functions tied to panel lighting. Aircraft requiring custom logic are not covered; installation uses MobiFlight BETA via a provided project file.

title: Synaptic A220 | WinCtrl RMP | MobiFlight Profile (COM1 + Squawk)
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for integrating the Synaptic A220 with the Winwing WinCtrl RMP (left unit). It enables COM1 standby frequency management with 8.33 kHz spacing, VHF transmit-select buttons and LEDs, and a transponder squawk code editor using the LOAD button. The profile also supports pedestal-lighting-linked backlighting but does not map HF, NAV, or related buttons not available in the A220 SDK. Installation requires MobiFlight BETA and setup through the "From Existing Project" option.

title: Fenix A32X B107 MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile adds B107 support for the Fenix A32X series, compatible with the A319, A320, and A321 aircraft, including both wing flex and sharklet variants. The profile currently includes core functionality with plans for future enhancements such as wiper, window heat, ground power, APU, and IRS controls. Designed to improve hardware integration and cockpit interaction. User feedback is encouraged for ongoing development and updates.

title: C172 G1000 Mobiflight Profile for WinWing
short_description: This add-on provides a comprehensive Mobiflight profile for the C172 G1000 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It supports a wide range of WinWing hardware devices for enhanced cockpit interaction. The package includes a detailed getting started guide covering installation steps and control mappings. Suitable for users seeking improved hardware integration with the C172 G1000.

title: Honeycomb Bravo | miniFCU | FSS 727 | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides custom MobiFlight profiles for the FlightSim Studio 727, tailored for Honeycomb Bravo and miniFCU hardware. It includes configuration for mode controls, autopilot functions, encoders, gear, switches, flaps, and lighting. The profiles are designed to enhance system compatibility and streamline control mapping within Microsoft Flight Simulator. Users can further set trim, axes, and reversers directly in the simulator.

title: Mobiprofile for Inibuilds a320 /a321 (Minicockpit FCU + EFIS and Honeycomb Bravo)
short_description: This add-on provides a comprehensive profile for the inibuilds A320/A321, designed for use with Minicockpits FCU and EFIS, as well as the Honeycomb Bravo throttle quadrant. It features fully functional buttons and displays, offering a universal solution compatible with various device configurations. Users are guided through setup instructions to customize the profile based on their equipment, streamlining the experience without the need for separate device-specific files.

title: B107 777
short_description: This is an early Mobiflight profile created for the PMDG 777-300ER in Microsoft Flight Simulator, with potential compatibility for the 777-200LR and Freighter variants. The profile includes essential overhead panel functions, with further updates planned to expand functionality. Current limitations include combined control of strobe and wheel well lights due to simulator constraints. User feedback is encouraged to help improve future versions.

title: FlightSimLabs A321 neo | WINCTRL TCAS | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile is created for the FlightSimLabs A321neo and enables hardware control of the TCAS system. It supports synchronized lighting, backlight, and display brightness, with real-time hardware feedback following the aircraft's status. The profile requires MobiFlight Connector v11.2.0 (Beta) or newer for full compatibility. Installation instructions are provided for both new and existing MobiFlight profiles.

title: Mobiflight Profile for the Headwind A339
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the Headwind A339 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and supports Winwing and Winctrl hardware, including MCDU panels, RMP units, ECAM, throttle, FCU, and EFIS modules. It offers mapped controls for both captain and first officer positions, but independent MCDU page operation is not currently supported due to aircraft limitations. The setup ensures compatibility with associated hardware, and includes special features and calibration guidance. Several aircraft controls and hardware-specific functions are retained, with known limitations detailed for certain functions and UI synchronisation.

title: WinWing Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a comprehensive MobiFlight profile for WinWing WinCtrl hardware modules, designed for use with the FBW A32NX in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It supports a variety of devices including FCU, EFIS, AGP, ECAM, ATC, RMP, MCDU, and throttle controls. Detailed setup instructions and calibration guidance are included, along with notes on supported and unsupported features. The profile has undergone extensive validation and testing for reliability and compatibility.

title: Mobiflight Profile for Winwing Fenix A321
short_description: This Mobiflight profile provides comprehensive support for Winwing and Winctrl hardware, including MCDU panels, RMP units, ECAM, throttle, FCU, and EFIS modules. It is tailored for use with the Fenix A321 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Both captain and first officer controls are covered. The profile has been tested to ensure compatibility and functionality with the relevant aircraft and hardware.

title: Rowsfire A107 Pro MF Config
short_description: This add-on provides a custom configuration file for the Rowsfire A107 Pro in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The file aims to enhance compatibility and user experience with the specific hardware. Users are advised to launch the simulator after setting up the configuration. Additional setup guidance may be available on the creator's YouTube channel.

title: Honeycomb Bravo MobiFlight profile for Fenix A320
short_description:
A complete MobiFlight profile for the Fenix A320 and Honeycomb Bravo in MSFS 2024. 
Includes FCU controls, Selected/Managed modes, selector-dependent encoder, AP LEDs, landing gear LEDs, warning lights and cockpit switches.

title: MobiFlight - WINCTRL RMP Profile for AEROSOFT A340-600 Pro
short_description: This add-on provides a custom MobiFlight profile for integrating the WINCTRL Radio Management Panel with the Aerosoft A340-600 Pro in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It supports RMP power control, frequency tuning, VHF1 and VHF2 selection, and corresponding LED indications. The system enables active and standby frequency display and transfer, with automatic switching based on VHF mode. Some RMP functions remain unassigned and VHF2 is mapped via the first officer's radio due to simulator limitations.

title: MobiFlight - WINCTRL 32 AGP Metal Profile for PMDG 777F
short_description: This add-on provides a custom MobiFlight profile for the WINCTRL 32 AGP Metal panel adapted to the PMDG 777F in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It repurposes Airbus-style buttons for Boeing-specific functions, including gear controls, full-range autobrake selector mapping, and detailed LED feedback. Additional features include TERR ON ND and clock controls. Compatibility is confirmed with MSFS 2024, the PMDG 777F, and the WINCTRL 32 AGP Metal hardware.

title: Daher TBM 930 MobiFlight for WinCtrl PAP 3
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the Daher TBM 930, enabling compatibility with the 3N PAP MAG panel for autopilot control. It supports both MAG and non-MAG configurations. Users receive LED and LCD feedback for enhanced situational awareness. Designed to streamline autopilot operations in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: MobiFlight Profile for WIngflex FCU (Fenix A320)
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile designed for the WingFlex FCU with the Fenix A320 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It offers an alternative to the Wingflex Bridge for users encountering aircraft recognition issues. The profile can be loaded directly into MobiFlight for improved hardware compatibility. It aims to enhance functionality for users with similar integration problems.

title: Rowsfire A106 Pro MobiFlight Profile | A330 Fleet
short_description: This add-on provides a custom MobiFlight profile specifically designed for the Rowsfire A106 Pro hardware, supporting the iniBuilds and Asobo Airbus A330 variants in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It enables full functionality for the Airbus A330-200, A330-300, Freighter, and VIP variants, with precise button mapping including specialized flap control. The profile can be imported directly into MobiFlight for immediate use. Partial compatibility is available for the Beluga, though some button actions may be reversed.

title: Honeycomb Bravo | miniFCU | Boeing 707-320C | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides custom MobiFlight profiles for the Boeing 707-320C in Microsoft Flight Simulator, supporting the Honeycomb Bravo and miniFCU hardware. It includes configurations for mode, autopilot, landing gear, trim, flaps, lights, and axis bindings for the Honeycomb Bravo. The miniFCU profile covers airspeed indicator, heading, altitude selection, and autopilot control. Designed to enhance compatibility and functionality for a more streamlined cockpit setup.

title: MobiFlight - WINCTRL URSA MINOR 32 Throttle Metal / 32 PAC Metal Profile for PMDG 777
short_description: MobiFlight profile for WINCTRL hardware and the PMDG 777F in MSFS 2024, including throttle/reverse logic, engine start, fuel controls, pumps with FAULT indications, spoilers, flaps, parking brake and rudder trim with display output.

title: WinCTRL RMP & TCAS Panel – MobiFlight Profile UNIVERSAL
short_description: This add-on provides a universal MobiFlight profile for the WinCTRL RMP and TCAS panels. It enables switching between COM1, COM2, NAV1, NAV2, and Transponder modes with LED feedback. The integration features ATC LED indication when the Transponder mode is active, and allows for detailed frequency and transponder tuning. The profile includes functionality for swapping between COM1 and COM2, ideal for online operations.

title: B787-10 WINCTRL PAP3 EFIS-L EFIS-R FMC PFP4 MOBIFLIGHT PROFILE
short_description:
This add-on is my Mobiflight profile for the WinCtrl PAP3, Left EFIS, Right EFIS, and FMC PFP4.

Unfortunately, not everything is available, but what I could find is included and works perfectly.

Download the latest beta version of Mobiflight.

This profile works in MSFS2020 and MSFS2024, and with the Asobo and Horizon B787-10 and B787-9.

You do not need SimAppPro for this.

title: Fenix A319-320-321 | WINCTRL TCAS | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a WINCTRL TCAS profile for the Fenix A319, A320, and A321 in Microsoft Flight Simulator, designed for use with MobiFlight Connector version 11.2.0 or later. It offers real-time synchronization of hardware lighting, backlighting, display brightness, LEDs, and indicator lights with the aircraft's systems. The profile enables accurate TCAS display integration with compatible hardware setups. Some functionality may be limited due to current simulator variable constraints.

title: Winctrl Mcdu Profile ATR42/72
short_description: This add-on provides a custom MCDU profile for the ATR 42 and 72 compatible with Mobiflight 11.2.0.4 BETA. The profile maps cockpit button functions according to real-world layouts, supporting a range of MCDU operations such as PERF, PROG, and EXEC. Not all functions are available in the simulator but main navigation and system keys are included. Installation involves loading the profile file through the Mobiflight interface.

title: WinCTRL iFLy 737 Max8 TCAS
short_description: This Mobiflight profile provides functionality for the WINCTRL TCAS panel, adapted for use with the iFly 737 Max 8 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It supports standard key and knob mappings tailored for both Airbus and Boeing panels, with specific adjustments for VATSIM and MSFS compatibility. The profile can be integrated into other compatible Mobiflight projects for the 737 Max 8. Note that the ATC FAIL light remains permanently illuminated due to a current limitation.

title: Winctrl PFP3N MCDU Profile for Inibuilds A350
short_description: This add-on provides a custom Winctrl PFP3N MCDU profile for the iniBuilds A350 in Microsoft Flight Simulator, utilizing the MobiFlight Connector. It features comprehensive keyboard and MCDU key bindings, following Boeing logic. The profile includes a fully synchronized lighting system, with hardware backlighting and annunciators that follow the aircraft state in real time. SimApp Pro is not required for use.

title: WingFlex FCU cube For PMDG737
short_description: This add-on provides a functional WingFlex FCU cube designed for use with the PMDG 737 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It aims to enhance cockpit interactions by replicating FCU controls. The creator reports reliable performance on their system. Compatibility and effectiveness may vary based on individual setups.

title: WingFlex FCU cube For PMDG777
short_description: This add-on provides functionality for the WingFlex FCU cube specifically designed for use with PMDG 777 aircraft models in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It is compatible with the 777-200ER, 777-200LR, 777F, and 777-300ER variants. The mod aims to enhance the control unit experience for these aircraft. Installation and operation details are based on a configuration that has been tested on a personal PC.

title: SYNAPTICS A220 | WINWING WinCtrl RMP | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This package offers a MobiFlight profile for basic integration of the SYNAPTICS A220 with the Winwing WinCtrl RMP. It enables COM1 standby tuning and transfer functionality. Users must enable the beta version in MobiFlight for compatibility. The profile is designed for straightforward import using the 'From Existing Project' option.

title: SYNAPTICS A220 | WINWING WinCtrl 32 MCDU  | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This package offers a MobiFlight profile enabling basic integration of the SYNAPTICS A220 with the Winwing WinCtrl 32 MCDU. It supports keyboard input, EXEC status light functionality, and Flight ID and scratchpad output through a companion app. Installation involves importing the profile via the MobiFlight software with beta features enabled. The add-on is intended for users combining these specific hardware components in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: Winctrl PFP3N Keyboard Mobiflight Profile for Synaptic Simulations A220
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables full keyboard control for the Synaptic Simulations A220-300 using the Winctrl PFP3N keypad. It supports major FMC and cockpit functions including EXEC, DIR, and RTE buttons, along with LED indicators for caution and warning. Display and backlight brightness can be adjusted according to cockpit pedestal knobs. Requires Mobiflight version 11.x or higher for installation.

title: A2A Piper PA-24 Comanche | Winwing PAP3+EFIS | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This addon provides a MobiFlight profile for integrating the Winwing PAP3 and EFIS panels with the A2A Piper PA-24 Comanche in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It enables full functionality of the 7-segment displays for speed, altitude, and heading without requiring SimAppPro. Button and knob assignments are clearly mapped for ease of use. Installation instructions for MobiFlight are included.

title: Ocatvi IFR1 Profile Synaptic A220
short_description: This add-on provides an AI-generated Ocatvi-IFR 1 profile for the Synaptic A220, adapting the Fenix A320 configuration. It is compatible with Mobiflight and requires loading the provided mcc file. The controls are mapped for efficient operation of navigation, speed, heading, altitude, and vertical speed or flight path angle. Key autopilot, transponder, and communication functions are supported as expected.

title: Mobiflight WINCTRL profile PMDG 777 MDCU + FCU + Rowsfire A101 lights
short_description: This Mobiflight WINCTRL profile is designed for use with the PMDG 777, supporting both the MDCU and FCU modules. It incorporates compatibility with Rowsfire A101 lighting controls. The profile is intended to be opened and used within the Mobiflight application. This add-on streamlines cockpit hardware integration for enhanced flight simulation realism.

title: Mobiflight WINCTRL profile A340-600PRO MDCU + FCU + Rowsfire A101 lights
short_description: This add-on provides Mobiflight profiles tailored for the Aerosoft A340-600PRO, supporting the MDCU, FCU, and Rowsfire A101 lighting panel. The configuration is designed to be used with the Mobiflight application. Compatibility is confirmed for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. These profiles allow seamless hardware integration for enhanced cockpit interaction.

title: Winctrl PAP 3 Hondajet Autopilot Profile Mobiflight
short_description: This is a Mobiflight profile for the Hondajet autopilot in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The profile provides custom functions such as enabling autothrottle with the SPEED button and activating the yaw damper with the CWS A button. The course LCD display is not fully configured. Designed to enhance autopilot controls for compatible hardware setups.

title: Universal Stopwatch & UTC Clock Profile for 32 AGP Metal Winctrl (MobiFlight) | MSFS 2024
short_description: This add-on offers a custom MobiFlight profile for the 32 AGP Metal Winctrl hardware, providing a universal stopwatch and seamless UTC (Zulu) clock integration for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. The stopwatch uses standalone logic with lap and split-time features, independent of aircraft type or developer. The profile ensures accurate timekeeping on your hardware without interfering with in-sim avionics. It supports any aircraft and manages dual four-digit displays for both minutes and seconds with zero-padded formatting.

title: Synaptic A220 WINCTRL PFP7 Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for using the PFP7 panel as an FMS keyboard with the Synaptic A220 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The configuration enables direct input to the aircraft’s FMS system through physical controls. Installation requires placing the provided files into the Mobiflight configuration directory. Specific configuration bindings are detailed in the documentation.

title: PMDG 737-800 – WINWING Airbus Throttle + FCU + EFIS for MSFS 2024
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile and setup guide for using the WINCTRL / WINWING URSA MINOR 32 Throttle Metal L, FCU and EFIS with the PMDG Boeing 737-800 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It includes throttle, reverse thrust, engine master, spoiler, flaps, gear, brake and trim functions, plus extended EFIS features such as QNH in hPa/inHg, STD display, BARO/RADIO minimums, CTR, TERR/WXR cycling, chronometers and illuminated EFIS buttons. The package includes screenshots and setup guidance for MobiFlight and SimAppPro. Designed and tested for the PMDG 737-800.

title: Synaptics + iniBuilds A220 / C Series | WINCTRL PAP 3 + 3M PDC L (MCP + EFIS L) | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This is a Mobiflight profile for the Synaptics and iniBuilds A220 C Series, designed for use with WINCTRL PAP 3 and 3M PDC L hardware. The profile maps autopilot and EFIS functions, including N1, SPD INT, FPV, FD, and VORLOC to specific panel controls. Known issues include incorrect HDG display in AUTO mode and a non-functional MACH display. The configuration is intended for advanced users seeking custom hardware integration.

title: PMDG 737 Complete Profile Mobiflight
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the MSFS PMDG 737 and supports a range of WINWING hardware products. It includes configurations for devices such as the Winctrl 3M PDC R, 3N PDC L, 3N PAP, and 3N PFP Captain units. Compatibility extends to the Rowsfire B107 737 Overhead Panel and PDS Fuel Box MAX. The profile enables integration between your flight simulator setup and supported hardware components.

title: The Ultimate Synaptic A22X WinCTRL MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables compatibility between the WinCTRL FCU, EFIS L, EFIS R, URSA MINOR 32 Throttle, PAC, and AGP hardware for the Synaptic A22X in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The configuration matches real A220 aircraft haptics and has been set up by an experienced A220 pilot. Some functions may be unavailable due to missing simulator variables as noted in the manual. Users are advised to consult the manual for accurate usage and hardware labeling details.

title: PROFIL A330 Inibuilds With RowsFire A107 V2
short_description: This add-on provides a custom profile file for the iniBuilds A330, designed specifically for compatibility with the RowsFire A107 V2 hardware unit. It includes detailed instructions for flashing the RowsFire device to work with MobiFlight. The package aims to streamline integration and enhance utility for users with supported hardware. All necessary files and procedures are provided in the zip download.

title: PROFIL A330 Inibuilds With Sim Gauges AIRBUS A320 LIGHTING PEDESTAL CAPT
short_description: This add-on provides a profile file for the iniBuilds A330, specifically designed to integrate with the SimGauges AIRBUS A320 LIGHTING PEDESTAL CAPT hardware. The included documentation details the procedure for configuring your SimGauges unit for compatibility with MobiFlight. Suitable for users wishing to enhance hardware support for the iniBuilds A330 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. All setup instructions are provided within the download.

title: PROFIL A330 Inibuilds With Sim Gauges AIRBUS A320 WX RADAR PANEL
short_description: This add-on provides a custom profile for the iniBuilds A330, specifically designed to work with the SimGauges AIRBUS A320 WX RADAR PANEL hardware. Included in the package is a step-by-step procedure for flashing the SimGauges unit for compatibility with MobiFlight. The profile simplifies integration between the aircraft and hardware panel for improved simulation realism. All required instructions are provided in the included documentation.

title: PROFIL A330 Inibuilds With Sim Gauges AIRBUS A320 Lighting Pedestal First Officer Side
short_description: This add-on provides a custom profile for the iniBuilds A330, designed to be used with the SimGauges Airbus A320 Lighting Pedestal First Officer Side hardware. It includes instructions for flashing the SimGauges unit for compatibility with MobiFlight. The package aims to facilitate hardware integration for a more immersive simulator experience. Suitable for users seeking enhanced cockpit realism.

title: PROFIL A330 Inibuilds With Sim Gauges AIRBUS A320 GLARE WING SET - CPT + FO
short_description: This add-on provides a custom profile file for the iniBuilds A330 aircraft, designed to work with the SimGauges AIRBUS A320 GLARE WING SET for both captain and first officer positions. The package includes step-by-step instructions for flashing your SimGauges device to ensure compatibility with MobiFlight. It enables streamlined integration and enhanced usability with specific simulator hardware. Suitable for users seeking to use their SimGauges glare wing set with the A330 in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: FSS 727 | WINCTRL PAP3/PDC | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile provides customized button and knob assignments for the FSS 727 aircraft using the WINCTRL PAP3 controller. It covers key autopilot, navigation, and control panel functions such as altitude, vertical speed, heading, and autothrottle. The configuration enables direct control of autopilot modes and reference settings. Installation involves downloading, unzipping, and loading the profile in MobiFlight.

title: PROFIL A330 Inibuilds With ACP SimGauges
short_description: This add-on provides a custom profile for the iniBuilds A330, configured to work with the SimGauges AIRBUS A320 ACP hardware. The profile includes mapping for most functions, except SAT1 and SAT2, which are not available on the hardware unit. It is intended to enhance compatibility between the aircraft and SimGauges device. The file is designed for users seeking a pre-configured control setup.

title: [Wingflex] PMDG777 Profile - Wingflex A320 Overhead Panel
short_description: This is an unofficial community profile for the PMDG 777 that maps A320 overhead panel functions to the aircraft using the Wingflex system. Various PMDG 777 and A320 controls are cross-mapped for improved compatibility. The profile has been tested only with the PMDG 777 and provides no guarantee of updates or support. It is not endorsed by Wingflex and is distributed as is.

title: [Wingflex] TFDI MD11 Profile - Wingflex Combo Cube (EFIS/FCU/RMP)
short_description: This unofficial community profile enables support for the Wingflex Combo Cube hardware with the TFDi MD-11 aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It provides integration for EFIS, FCU, and RMP modules, though some display and lighting elements may not function as expected. Certain features, such as transponder code entry and expanded RMP support, are not implemented. The profile is provided as is without official support or guaranteed updates.

title: [Wingflex] TFDI MD11 Profile - Wingflex A320 Overhead Panel
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables the use of the Wingflex A320 Overhead Panel with the TFDi Design MD-11 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Several key MD-11 functions are mapped to corresponding hardware switches, although not all features are supported due to panel differences. The profile has been tested only in MSFS 2024 and is provided without official support or ongoing updates. Some aircraft functions may have unique behaviors or limitations in use.

title: Mobiflight MCDU Profile for the Just Flight Fokker F70/100 NO DISPLAY OUTPUT
short_description: This add-on offers a MobiFlight profile for the WinCtrl MCDU, tailored specifically for the Just Flight Fokker F70 and F100 aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It is compatible with MSFS 2024 and expected to function in MSFS 2020. The profile is designed for the captain side only. MCDU display output is not supported in this version.

title: [Wingflex] PMDG737 - Wingflex A320 Overhead Panel
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables the Wingflex A320 Overhead Panel to interface with the PMDG737 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Some hardware functions have been remapped due to differences between the aircraft types. Not all overhead functions are available, and update support is not guaranteed. This profile is unofficial and not endorsed by Wingflex.

title: Wingflex RMP Cube - iniBuilds A350 Profile
short_description: This flight profile is designed for Wingflex RMP Cube to work with iniBuild A350. It supports VHF1 and VHF2, active/standby swap, and both inner and outer knob functions. The configuration has been tested with Mobiflight version 11.1.0.8. Compatibility has been verified exclusively on Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

title: iFly 737 Max WINCTRL PFP7 CDU Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables compatibility between the WINCTRL PFP7 CDU and the iFly 737 Max in Microsoft Flight Simulator. All buttons on the PFP7 are mapped according to their layout, with specific exceptions noted for N1 LIMIT and ATC. LED indicators and the display are fully functional, though the display brightness cannot be adjusted via the physical BRT button. The profile is designed to streamline hardware integration for enhanced operability.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) MCDU | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables WINCTRL MCDU hardware compatibility with the iniBuilds Airbus A350-900 and A350-1000 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It provides synchronized backlighting, LEDs, and annunciators that reflect the aircraft's real-time state. The profile supports most MCDU controls but excludes PROG, DATA, AIRPORT, and OVFY functions. MobiFlight Connector v11.1.0.8 (Beta) or newer is required for full functionality.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) RMP | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables compatibility between the WINCTRL RMP hardware and the iniBuilds Airbus A350-900 and A350-1000 for Microsoft Flight Simulator. It synchronizes lighting and RMP controls, including backlighting and real-time hardware response according to aircraft state. The profile supports essential functions such as VHF1, VHF2, HF1, frequency swap, and ON/OFF. Mobiflight Connector version 11.1.0.8 (Beta) or newer is required for full functionality.

title: Winctrl TCAS Mobiflight profile for FBW A32NX-Dev for MSFS2020/2024
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile specifically for the Winctrl TCAS, designed for use with the FBW A32NX Development version in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. The profile was created with the latest beta of Mobiflight and is reported to be working for MSFS2024. Installation involves unzipping and placing the mfproj file in the usual Mobiflight project directory. No known issues have been reported with the current versions used.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) AGP | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables integration of the WINCTRL 32 AGP Metal hardware with the iniBuilds Airbus A350-900 and A350-1000 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It supports real-time hardware lighting synchronization, AGP display synchronization, and extensive aircraft control mappings. SimApp Pro is not required, but MobiFlight Connector v11.1.0.8 (Beta) or later is necessary for full functionality. Some features such as the UTC GPS/INT/SET switch are not supported.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) TCAS | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables full TCAS control integration for the iniBuilds Airbus A350-900 and A350-1000 using the WINCTRL 32 hardware. It provides synchronized lighting and TCAS display functions without requiring SimApp Pro. Most TCAS controls are supported, including mode and XPDR selectors, IDENT, and code entry, with the exception of the ALT RPTG switch. The profile requires Mobiflight Connector version 11.1.0.8 (Beta) or newer for optimal compatibility.

title: MadDog PAP3 and PFP
short_description: This add-on provides a custom configuration profile for the MD80 series, tailored to work with both PAP3 and PFP systems. It is intended for use in VATSIM flights. The profile is assembled from existing online profiles to ensure better compatibility. Users may encounter minor configuration errors due to integration from multiple sources.

title: IFly Max 8 Mobi Profile PAP3/PFP
short_description: This add-on provides a custom MobiFlight profile for the IFly Max 8, combining settings compatible with PAP3 and PFP. It is designed for pilots using VATSIM who require a unified configuration for these platforms. The profile merges publicly available configurations to ensure improved compatibility. Some minor errors may be present, as it is a user-created combination.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) Joystick | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This is a MobiFlight profile for the WINWING URSA MINOR 32 joystick, tailored for the iniBuilds Airbus A350-900 and A350-1000 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The profile supports hardware output functions such as synchronized lighting and vibration, reflecting aircraft states in real time. No SimApp Pro is required, but MobiFlight Connector v11.1.0.8 Beta or newer is necessary for full functionality. Input and button mapping are not included; only output features are provided.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) Throttle Metal & PAC Metal | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables synchronized output functions such as lighting and vibration simulation for the Winwing URSA MINOR 32 Throttle Metal and PAC Metal hardware with the iniBuilds Airbus A350-900 and A350-1000 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It requires Mobiflight Connector v11.1.0.8 (Beta) or later for full functionality. This profile provides real-time hardware feedback but does not include button input mappings. Compatibility is verified for setups using both throttle and PAC units together.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) ECAM | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables complete integration of WINWING ECAM hardware with the iniBuilds Airbus A350-900 and A350-1000 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. ECAM displays, lighting, annunciators, and backlighting are fully synchronized with the simulator, with no need for SimApp Pro. The profile is tested for use with MobiFlight Connector version 11.1.0.8 (Beta) or newer. Detailed button mappings are provided in included reference images.

title: Inibuilds Airbus A350-900/1000 | WINCTRL(Winwing) FCU+EFIS  L&R | Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables full integration of WINWING FCU and EFIS panels with the iniBuilds Airbus A350-900 and A350-1000 for Microsoft Flight Simulator. It provides real-time synchronized lighting, display, and control functions for both FCU and EFIS components. Operation is supported via Mobiflight Connector v11.1.0.8 (Beta) or newer, without the need for SimApp Pro. Detailed button mappings and control assignments are included with the download.

title: Winwing MCDU (Airbus) → Contrail Falcon 50 GNS-XLS Key Mapping for MobiFlight
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight configuration to map all keys of the Airbus-style Winwing MCDU hardware for use with the GNS-XLS flight management system in the Contrail Falcon 50. It includes a full key-mapping reference and repurposes unused keys for functions not present on the Airbus unit. The package ensures that every mapped key triggers the correct Falcon 50 FMS event, with mappings based on official aircraft definitions. Requires Contrail Falcon 50, Winwing MCDU-32 hardware, and MobiFlight Connector.

title: MobiFlight SR22T Project WinCtrl EFIS - MCP
short_description: This add-on integrates the SR22T aircraft from Asobo with Mobiflight, enabling compatibility with the Wingwin EFIS and MCP panels. It maps key autopilot and cockpit functions such as barometric pressure, heading, speed, lights, autopilot modes, and vertical navigation. Controls like knobs and buttons are assigned to operate various flight parameters, mirroring real-world cockpit behavior. This setup enhances hardware interaction for users of the SR22T in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: Hoowalt D201 PMDG 777 MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables basic functionality of the Hoowalt D201 Radio Panel with the PMDG 777 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. Supported features include VHF1 and VHF2 operation, standby frequency selection, and frequency transfer. All other functions are not supported. The profile is designed for simple radio communications within the aircraft.

title: Mobiflight Just Flight Fokker100/70 MINIFCU + MINIEFIS LEFT
short_description: This MobiFlight profile provides mappings for the miniCOCKPIT MiniFCU and MiniEFIS Left hardware to the Just Flight Fokker 70 and 100 aircraft, integrating with their custom LVAR logic. All relevant autopilot, flight director, and EFIS functions are assigned for the left side controls. The speed display is configured to show IAS in knots and switches to Mach when that mode is active. This setup is specifically tailored for compatibility with the Just Flight Fokker 70 and 100 in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: Mobiflight WinCTRL FCU/EFIS/THROTTLE Profile for JustFlight Fokker 70/100
short_description: This is a Mobiflight profile for the JustFlight Fokker 70/100, supporting WinCTRL Airbus FCU, left and right EFIS panels, and specific controls for Ursa minor throttles. The project file allows customized hardware mapping, with options to remove components you do not have. Several functions are fully supported, although some buttons and lights remain inoperative due to simulator limitations. Mobiflight software must support mfproj files to use this add-on.

title: MobiFlight Phenom 300 Project WinCtrl EFIS - MCP
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight configuration for the Phenom 300 using the WinCtrl EFIS and MCP hardware. It enables control of essential aircraft systems such as barometric settings, flight director, lighting, autopilot, and navigation modes. The setup includes dedicated knob functions for speed, heading, altitude, and vertical speed adjustments. Designed to streamline simulator hardware integration for improved realism and usability.

title: FLYBYWIRE A380X | WINWING WinCtrl RMP | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This package provides a basic integration for the FLYBYWIRE A380X when used together with MobiFlight and the Winctrl RMP.

title: DAP 500 GA
short_description: This is a Mobiflight profile tailored for the WingFlex DAP 500 general aviation panel. It enables full button functionality and links the LVL button to autopilot features. The backlight is connected to the battery switch, and indicator lights are operational. The profile can serve as a template for further customization.

title: WinWing FCU Radio Panel - Fenix A320
short_description: This add-on enables the WinWing FCU to function as a COM1 radio panel for the Fenix A320 series using a MobiFlight profile. Users can easily toggle between normal FCU operation and radio tuning mode with a single button. The SPD and HDG knobs adjust MHz and kHz, while push functions swap active and standby frequencies, all displayed on the FCU. Normal flight control operations remain fully available when not in radio mode.

title: Rowsfire ECAM
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight configuration file for the Rowsfire A109v3 ECAM, specifically tailored for the FBW A320NX. It enables full functionality for all buttons, LEDs, and switches, except for the ALL function, which is not typically used. Users should note that knobs controlling the upper and lower display may not work properly. Designed to enhance hardware integration with the A320NX ECAM system.

title: Rowsfire A106 Pro - Aerosoft ToLiss A340-600 Pro MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the Rowsfire A106 Mini Overhead Panel, tailored specifically for the Aerosoft and ToLiss A340-600 Pro in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It maps key Airbus overhead functions such as batteries, external power, APU, lighting, anti-ice, packs, and fuel pumps. The profile is adjusted for the unique overhead and fuel system of the A340-600. Compatibility has been tested and confirmed with the listed aircraft in MSFS 2024.

title: Skyward Citation Sovereign+ | WINCTRL FCU+EFIS | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile is designed for the Skyward Citation Sovereign+ in MSFS2024, specifically for use with the WinCTRL FCU and EFIS panels. It offers separate configurations for Captain, First Officer, and dimmer-adjusted backlighting. The profile uses push and pull FCU logic similar to Airbus, with some adaptations for this aircraft. The AP2 button is mapped to Yaw Damper, and additional test features are included for FCU and BARO control.

title: Mobi Flight Profile IFly MAX for WInCtrl PFP3
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the IFly MAX PFP3, mapping key autopilot functions such as CLB, CRZ, and DES to VNAV controls. ATC and FMC COMM buttons are not configured in this profile. Installation requires uploading the profile to MobiFlight and linking it to the PFP3 FMS. The package is designed for streamlined integration with compatible hardware setups.

title: IFLY 737 MAX | WINWING WinCtrl RMP | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a basic MobiFlight profile for integrating the IFLY 737 MAX with the Winwing WinCtrl RMP in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It is a beta release and some features, such as HF1, HF2, and VHF3 data display, are not yet functional. Backlight control is operational. The package requires the latest beta version of MobiFlight for correct functionality.

title: INIBUILDS A350 | WINWING WinCtrl RMP | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the INIBUILDS A350 series, designed for use with the WINWING WinCtrl RMP hardware. It enables backlight control, frequency tuning, and transmitter selection for VHF1 and VHF2. VHF3, HF1, and HF2 are currently not functional due to simulator limitations. Compatibility is limited to a specific development version of MobiFlight.

title: Rowsfire A103 - PMDG 777 Config - Mobiflight
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight configuration file tailored for the Rowsfire A103 ECAM Panel, optimized for compatibility with the PMDG 777 series in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It enables integration of physical hardware with the aircraft’s electronic systems. The configuration supports enhanced interaction and usability. User feedback and suggestions for profile improvements are welcomed.

title: PMDG 737 & 777 | WINWING WinCtrl RMP | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This package provides a complete integration for the PMDG 737 (all variants) and PMDG 777 (all variants) when used together with MobiFlight and the Winctrl RMP.

title: Winctrl RMP profile for Fenix A32x
short_description: This is a MobiFlight profile designed for the Fenix A32X aircraft family, specifically tailored for use with the RMP 32 hardware device. It offers full functionality of backlights, buttons, LEDs, and the LCD screen when used with the development version of MobiFlight. Compatibility with the stable version is limited to buttons and encoders.  The latest BETA release includes the support rot WinCTRL RMP

title: WBSim 152 Mobiflight profile for Winwing PAP3 Glareshield
short_description: This is a Mobiflight profile designed for the WBSim and JP Logistics Cessna 152, compatible with the Winwing PAP3 Glareshield panel. It includes integrated support for panel backlighting, LCD functions, and autopilot button logic that mirrors aircraft status. Additional optional controls for the Thrustmaster Boeing Yoke are included but can be removed if not needed. The profile provides realistic behavior such as dynamic lighting responses linked to aircraft power states.

title: FSS EMB 190/170/F FCU mobiflight WINCTRL profile
short_description: This profile provides a set of pre-configured Mobiflight and WINCTRL mappings for the Flight Control Unit of the FSS Embraer 190 and 170 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The layout matches key functions of the e-jets glareshield, including control over speed, heading, altitude, and autopilot features. A text file is included summarizing all command conversions for easier setup. Intended to assist users integrating external controllers with the FSS E-Jets series.

title: Winctrl FCU+EFIS L R | MCDU | AGP Metal | Throttle Metal / PAC Metal | TCAS | RMP | FENIX A320
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for integration with FCU, MCDU, both left and right EFIS, AGP32, ATC/TCAS, and throttle quadrant hardware. It is designed for compatibility with various URSA MINOR 32 series metal controls. The profile aims to streamline and support operations across supported devices. Functionality is based on the creator's setup and may vary with different hardware configurations.

title: SL3 PANELS // FSLABS A321 NEO & CEO // MobiFlight profile
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the FSLABS A321 Neo and CEO in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It includes assignments for autoflight, both captain and first officer navigation displays, landing gear, and captain glarewing warning controls using SL3 Panels. The latest beta version of Mobiflight is required. Instructions are included for setup and installation.

title: FBW A32NX | MiniCockpit MiniFCU+MiniEFIS+MiniOVHD | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: This MobiFlight profile enables integration of MiniCockpit MiniFCU, MiniEFIS, and MiniOVHD hardware with the FBW A32NX on the Dev Branch. Designed for the latest Beta versions of MobiFlight and using the mfproj file format, it is compatible with MSFS 2020 and 2024. The profile features a minor adjustment, repurposing the Probe and Window Heat button for Fuel Pumps functionality.

title: Winwing/WingCTRL MobiFlight Profile for PFP3N (PMDG 777F)
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile tailored for the WingCtrl PFP3N hardware, specifically tested with the PMDG 777F aircraft. It includes full button configurations and integrates functional warning lights using the PFP3N panel. The profile is designed to enhance compatibility between the hardware and the aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator. All setup details are included to facilitate easy implementation.

title: FSLabs | WINCTRL Throttle and Sidestick L | Engines Vibration Profile for Mobiflight
short_description: This MobiFlight profile introduces vibration feedback to the WINCTRL sidestick and throttle for enhanced realism in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It requires MobiFlight version 11.0.1.2 or higher and can be integrated with existing profiles or used independently. Users without the specific hardware may disable relevant settings. The add-on aims to provide a more immersive tactile experience during flight.

title: Rowsfire A103 - iniBuilds A350 Config - Mobiflight
short_description: This add-on provides a configuration file for integrating the Rowsfire A103 ECAM Panel with the iniBuilds A350 in Microsoft Flight Simulator using Mobiflight. It is designed to enhance hardware compatibility and efficiency for cockpit builders. Users can report issues or suggest improvements for future profiles. Suitable for simmers using the Rowsfire A103 with the iniBuilds A350 aircraft.

title: Cirrus Vision Jet for WinWing PAP3
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the Cirrus Vision Jet to be used with the WinWing PAP3 hardware. It includes mapped controls for key aircraft functions such as auto throttle and manual speed adjustment. Known limitations include the auto throttle arm light not illuminating due to a simulator bug. The profile is configured for a manual speed mode preference over FMS.

title: Mobiflight Rowsfire B107 Profile for iFly 737 MAX8
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for integrating the ROWSFIRE B107 overhead panel with the iFly 737 MAX8 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. Some automation relies an external app. Updates are planned to improve compatibility and automation in future releases.

title: PFP4 PMDG 777 MobiFlight profile
short_description: This add-on provides a custom MobiFlight profile for the PMDG 777, designed specifically for use with the WinWing PFP4 hardware. It enables users to interface their PFP4 with the PMDG 777 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. The profile aims to enhance compatibility and functionality for this aircraft and control setup. Suitable for those seeking tailored hardware integration.

title: Fenix A320 MobiFlight Configuration for WinCTRL Devices
short_description: This MobiFlight configuration profile is designed for integrating Fenix A320 simulation with Winwing and URSA MINOR hardware, including throttle, joystick, and ECAM panels. It offers tailored mappings, adapted logic, and operationally accurate control assignments for a cohesive cockpit experience. The current version supports core hardware components, with future updates planned for further functionality and device support. Intended as a practical, expandable foundation, it streamlines complex setup processes for users of Fenix A320 and Winwing hardware via MobiFlight.

title: Fenix A320 Winwing Winctrl AGP and ECAM Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables full compatibility between the Winwing Winctrl 32 AGP and 32 ECAM hardware and the Fenix A320 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Clock functions including CHR, UTC, and ET are supported with accurate behavior. The profile is designed specifically for use with the Fenix A320 family. Feedback and bug reports from users are encouraged.

title: Fenix A320 Winwing Winctrl URSA MINOR Throttle and PAC Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the Winwing Winctrl URSA MINOR Throttle and 32 PAC hardware. It is intended for use with the Fenix A320 aircraft family in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. The profile aims to provide seamless hardware integration and control. It has been tested and verified for compatibility with the specified aircraft and simulator version.

title: iFly 737-8 Mobiflight Profile for Winwing PFP4
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the iFly 737-8 and optimized for use with the Winwing PFP4 hardware. It provides functional mapping intended for the captain side controls. Users have the option to adjust the configuration for alternate cockpit positions as needed. The profile aims to streamline cockpit interaction for the iFly 737-8 in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: Mobiflight profile for MSFS IniBuilds A300
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is developed for the iniBuilds A300 in Microsoft Flight Simulator and tested with MSFS 2024. It offers multi-instrument support, covering modules such as SimGauges Overhead, ECAM, EFIS, FCU, MCDU keys, and throttle controls. The profile maps various aircraft controls and buttons, with specific adaptations for compatibility. Users can select and edit the instruments needed for their setup; support and updates are not planned.

title: TFDi MD-11 Sim Gauges Overhead Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a basic Mobiflight profile for the TFDi MD-11, enabling core overhead panel functions for a standard flight. It covers essential operations such as seatbelt annunciators, master caution, and various light switches. Some control mapping adjustments are noted for specific switches and annunciators. The profile offers essential features with the possibility for future updates.

title: MobiFlight Profile for WinCtrl ECAM Lights (Fenix A320)
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the WinCtrl ECAM panel to allow control of various Fenix A320 lighting and passenger sign functions using previously unassigned buttons. Button bindings include landing lights, strobe lights, RWY turnoff, and nose lights. Additional optional bindings on the throttle let users control beacon lights and seatbelt signs with engine fire buttons. All button functions can be customized within the MobiFlight program.

title: WINGFLEX FCU for inibuilds A400M
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the WingFlex FCU, specifically designed for the iniBuilds A400M aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It enables full usage of the FCU’s autopilot and autothrust functions, including speed, heading, climb, and descent modes, with the exception of FPA descent due to a current aircraft limitation. The profile requires the latest version of MobiFlight for proper functionality. Installation instructions are included for easy setup with MSFS 2024.

title: Boeing Pap3 Inibuilds Airbus Template
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile enabling WinWing Boeing PAP3 hardware to control autopilot functions in the iniBuilds A320neo v2 and other Airbus aircraft. It offers full synchronization of airspeed, heading, altitude, and vertical speed between the hardware and simulator. The profile is primarily tested on the A320neo v2 and is compatible with other iniBuilds models. Some features, such as button LEDs and switch mappings, are still under development.

title: Mobiflight Profile for Winctrl MCDU (cpt side, just input)
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the Winctrl MCDU hardware in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It enables input functionality for the captain's side MCDU, without display output support. The add-on is specific to the Winctrl (formerly Winwing) MCDU device. User feedback and suggestions for improvements are welcome.

title: iFly 737 MAX Sim Gauges Overhead Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a basic Mobiflight profile tailored for the iFly 737 MAX, focusing on the overhead panel gauges. It enables most essential functions needed for standard point-to-point flights. The profile currently has limited output events and is designed for simplicity. Future updates may be considered but are not guaranteed.

title: Aerosoft CRJ Sim Gauges Overhead Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This is a basic Mobiflight profile designed for the Aerosoft CRJ, enabling core overhead functions needed for standard flights. Most essential controls for A to B operations are included. The profile currently includes limited output events. Panel lights can be managed using a potentiometer setup.

title: Rowsfire A107 v3.1 // AEROSOFT A340-600pro // Mobiflight profile
short_description: This Mobiflight profile is designed for the Rowsfire OVHD A107 V3.1 and the Aerosoft A340-600PRO add-on in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Compatibility with MSFS2020 has not been tested. The profile requires the latest beta version of Mobiflight and provides mapped functions for the specified hardware. Installation involves unzipping and loading the profile into Mobiflight.

title: Aerosoft/ToLiss A340-600 Pro WinCtrl FCU + EFIS Profile for Mobiflight
short_description: This add-on offers a custom MobiFlight profile tailored for the Aerosoft and ToLiss A340-600 aircraft, optimized for use with WinCtrl FCU and EFIS hardware controllers. It facilitates integrated control of key cockpit functions in Microsoft Flight Simulator. Some hardware features, such as the EXEPDite button and EFIS pressure unit display, have partial limitations due to software constraints. Installation is completed by loading the configuration file within MobiFlight.

title: MobiFlight Plugin for MSFS 2024 WT21 CDU (e.g. CJ4)
short_description: This add-on integrates MobiFlight CDU support for the WT21 CDUs in MSFS 2024. It offers plugin activation settings and optional display of FMC messages in the scratchpad. Included MobiFlight profiles allow mapping WinWing CDU buttons to WT21 controls. The plugin is open-source under the MIT license.

title: Aerosoft A340-600 WINCTRL ECAM Profile
short_description: This addon provides a Mobiflight profile for using the WinCTRL ECAM with the Aerosoft A340-600 in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It requires Mobiflight 10.5+ BETA and initial manual adjustment for orphaned controller mapping. The profile features customized controls for backlighting, LED brightness, and ELEC systems. Additional button mappings include specific functions for the C/B page and unused buttons for user customization.

title: Aerosoft A340-600 Winctrl Efis-FCU Capt/FO MCDU Capt
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the Aerosoft A340-600 and supports the Winctrl FCU and EFIS for the captain and first officer, as well as the captain's MCDU. The profile enables the functionality of all controls, including LCD dimming and backlighting. The on-screen displays are functional with minor limitations.

title: A340-600 Mobiflight WinCTRL FCU & L EFIS
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables functionality for the WinCTRL FCU and left EFIS panels in the Aerosoft A340-600. The FCU panel supports full button and knob use, with operational value changes, though in-cockpit animations are not yet supported. The EFIS section currently has working barometric and FS and LS button controls, while other features remain in progress. Compatibility is confirmed for the 2020 version only and has not been tested in 2024.

title: Aerosoft A340-600 Winctrl MCDU CAPT+FO Profile for Mobiflight
short_description: This Mobiflight profile enables full functionality of all buttons and LEDs, including backlight and LED brightness, for the Winctrl MCDU Captain, First Officer and 3rd MCDU panels on the Aerosoft A340-600. Mobiflight 11.1.0.3 or newer and Aircraft 1.0.3 required for full compatibility

title: MiniFCU + Efis Mobiflight Profile for Aerosoft A340-600
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the Minicockpit FCU and EFIS, specifically designed for the Aerosoft A340-600. It requires Mobiflight version 10.5.23.24 or newer to function properly. The Exped button is assigned to the ALT function within the simulator. Note that some buttons and switches may not animate due to aircraft coding limitations.

title: Rowsfire A101 IniBuilds A340-300 Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a complete Mobiflight profile for the IniBuilds A340-300, optimized for compatibility with the Rowsfire A101 hardware. The profile enables seamless integration and enhanced control of the aircraft systems. Mobiflight version 10.5.0 is required for use. Designed for users seeking to utilize custom hardware setups with the A340-300 in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: Winwing PAP 3 autopilot for Diamond DA62
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight configuration tailored for the Winwing PAP3 autopilot panel, specifically designed for the Diamond DA62 aircraft. It allows users to integrate and control the DA62 autopilot functions with the PAP3 hardware. The profile aims to enhance hardware compatibility and streamline cockpit operations. Suitable for sim pilots utilizing the Winwing PAP3 with Microsoft Flight Simulator's Diamond DA62.

title: Winwin PAP3 Grand Caravan autopilot
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile designed for the Winwing PAP 3 autopilot panel in the Grand Caravan. It enables enhanced compatibility and functionality between the Winwing hardware and Microsoft Flight Simulator. The configuration ensures accurate autopilot operations within the Grand Caravan. Intended for users utilizing Winwing PAP 3 hardware with Mobiflight integration.

title: Winwing PAP3 autopilot Cessna C400 Corvalis
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight project and profile designed specifically for the Cessna C400 Corvalis in Microsoft Flight Simulator. It enables integration and control of the PAP3 autopilot system. Users can enhance their cockpit hardware setup by connecting compatible controls. The mod is tailored to improve the realism and functionality of the Corvalis autopilot experience.

title: Complete WinCtrl Mobiflight Bundle for Fenix A32X
short_description: This Mobiflight bundle provides comprehensive profiles for the Fenix A32X, covering WinCtrl Airbus FCU, EFIS panels, MCDU, ECAM, airline joystick, throttle, PAC, AGP, TCAS, RMP, and NWS hardware. The package integrates correct lighting dependencies, customized button assignments, and enhanced synchronization across multiple panels. Custom functions are included for extra buttons and improved in-cockpit interaction. Installation requires Mobiflight Beta / Version 11 and manual hardware assignment.

title: WinCTRL 32 ECAM  for // FSLABS A321 Neo// MSFS24 Mobiflight Profile
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile specifically for the WinCTRL 32 ECAM hardware, tailored for use with the FSLABS A321 Neo in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 and 2024. It requires Mobiflight version 10.5.3.21 or higher. The profile enables integration of the hardware panel with the aircraft's ECAM systems. Installation involves unzipping and loading the profile into Mobiflight.

title: Rowsfire A107 v3.1 // FSLABS A321 NEO // Mobiflight profile
short_description: This add-on provides a completed Mobiflight configuration profile for the FSLABS A321 neo aircraft. It includes support for most aircraft functions except for battery voltage readings and the use of engine and APU fire test buttons. The profile aims to enhance hardware integration with the Rowsfire A107 and FSLABS A321. Users can expect broad compatibility with standard controls, excluding the specified limitations.

title: Mobiflight Profile - Fenix A320 - WinCtrl AGP Metal
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the WinCTRL AGP Metal device, tailored for use with the Fenix A320. It includes configurable options for TERR ON ND, allowing selection for either CPT or FO sides. The profile features known bugs such as non-blinking items on the UTC clock and a missing colon on the ET clock. Designed to enhance cockpit hardware interaction with the Fenix A320 in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: GKS B-52H Mobi Flight Profile for the Bravo Quadrant
short_description: This add-on provides a MobiFlight profile for the GKS B-52H, specifically designed for the Honeycomb Bravo Throttle Quadrant. The configuration can be adapted for use with Saitek and other compatible throttle quadrants. Users must update to MobiFlight 11 Beta for functionality. Attribution to the original creators is requested if modifications are made.

title: TFDI MD11 WINCTRL PAP3 - PFP 3N - 3N PDC L - TCA Captain Pack Airbus Edition / MSFS 2024
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the TFDI MD11 in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, specifically tailored for use with the Thrustmaster TCA Captain Pack Airbus Edition. The package enables integration of various WINCTRL, PDC, and FMC functions. It requires the latest Mobiflight beta version for full compatibility. Over 130 input and output configurations are included, with ongoing updates planned.

title: Mobiflight profile for Fenix A320 and WinCtrl/WinWiing URSA Throttle
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile designed specifically for the Fenix A320 and WinCTRL URSA throttle. It includes functionality for backlighting and LCD integration with the WinCTRL Flight Control Unit (FCU). The profile enhances the interaction between the throttle and the aircraft systems within Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: WINWING / WINCTRL PAP3, 3N PDC Mobiflight Profile for FlightFX Honda Jet
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile specifically designed for the FlightFX Honda Jet, compatible with WINWING/WINCTRL PAP3 and 3N PDC EFIS modules. Users should ensure they have the latest beta version of Mobiflight and properly map their devices to the profile for optimal use. Detailed assignments are available in the accompanying images for reference.

title: TFDI MD-11 Profile for Winwings  PFP3N
short_description: This add-on provides a modified Mobiflight profile for the TDFI MD-11 captain MCDU, designed for use with Winwings PFP3N. The keyboard layout is specifically structured to align with the MD-11 MCDU functions, with presets for various operational modes such as ENG OUT, INIT, and PROG. This profile enhances functionality and user experience by streamlining access to essential flight management commands.

title: Fenix A319 / A320 / A321 | WINCTRL 32 ECAM | MobiFlight Profile
short_description: The Fenix A319/A320/A321 WINCTRL 32 ECAM MobiFlight Profile is designed for users of Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020/2024. This add-on provides a dedicated profile compatible with various hardware including WinCTRL 32 ECAM and FCU-32 firmware. To utilize this profile, users must have MobiFlight version 10.5.3.21 or later, allowing for easy assignment to local controllers for enhanced simulation functionality.

title: Mobiflight Profile - Fenix A320 - WinCtrl Throttle PAC
short_description: This Mobiflight Profile is designed for the Fenix A320 and facilitates integration with the WinCtrl Ursa Minor Throttle and PAC Flaps/Speedbrake Panel. It has been tested and optimized for use with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Users can simply add the profile to Mobiflight for enhanced aircraft control.

title: Mobiflight FBW A380 Profile for WinCTRL MCDU
short_description: The Mobiflight FBW A380 Profile for WinCTRL MCDU provides a comprehensive mapping of 70 buttons from the Winwing MCDU CDU (Captain) to the FlyByWire A380X KCCU using the official A380X Flight Deck API H:Events. This add-on includes 74 configuration items allowing for navigation, input, and control of the A380X MFD pages directly through the Winwing CDU hardware, although it does not display text due to the graphical nature of the A380X MFD. Installation requires MobiFlight Connector and compatible hardware, ensuring full functionality within Microsoft Flight Simulator.

title: Mobiflight iFly 737 MAX Profile for WINWING/WINCTRL MCDU
short_description: This add-on provides a Mobiflight profile for the Winwing Airbus MCDU designed for the iFly 737 MAX in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 and 2024.
